# EAM algae content
Used to create Fig 1 EAM composition graphs
```{r}
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

eam.content <- read.table("EAM_stomachcontent_SG.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) ## This says stomach content, but this is the EAM food source

# Summary statistics table
eam.content.summary <- eam.content %>%
  group_by(Site, StomachContent, Location) %>%
  get_summary_stats(Content, type = "full") %>%
  mutate(mean_p_se = mean + se, mean_m_se = mean - se)

ggplot(eam.content.summary, aes(x = StomachContent, y = mean)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill = StomachContent),position = "stack") +
   scale_fill_manual(values=c("forestgreen", "dodgerblue2", "chocolate4", "gold1")) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_m_se, ymax = mean_p_se), width = 0.1, position = "identity") +
    facet_grid(~Location*Site, scales = "free_x") +
theme(aspect.ratio = 1, legend.position = "right") +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11)) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), legend.title = element_text(size = 11), legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + labs(fill = NULL) +   
    ylab("EAM food source Content (%)") +
    xlab("Site") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))  # USED = recreated in illustrator
```

## ADONIS 
### EAM content 

```{r echo=TRUE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=60)}
library(vegan)

eam.content <- read.table("EAM_permanova_algaecontent2.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(sum = Algae + Detritus + Animalmatter + Other) %>%
  filter(sum != 0.00) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sum)

# To set rownames
rownames(eam.content) <- eam.content$SampleID
eam.content$SampleID <- NULL
eam.content <- as.matrix(eam.content)

sampledf <- data.frame(sample_data(sampledata)) %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% rownames(eam.content))
rownames(sampledf) <- sampledf$SampleID
sampledf$SampleID <- NULL

# As our data are basically abundance-based data, we have to calculate Bray-Curtis distances
dis <- vegdist(eam.content, method = "euclidean")

adonis2(dis ~ Location/Site, data = sampledf, by = "terms")

### SITE NESTED IN LOCATION PERMDISP:
beta.site <- betadisper(dis, sampledf$Site)

permutest(beta.site,  permutations = 999,  strata = sampledf$Location)

```

Univariate analyses were run after this to test for differences in independent diet components individually)

### lmer univariate tests
```{r}
library(lmerTest)

eam.content <- read.table("EAM_stomachcontent_SG.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) ## This says stomach content, but this is the EAM food source

# Algae:
eam.content.algae <- eam.content %>%
  dplyr::filter(StomachContent == "Algae")

eam.lme.algaecontent <- lmer(Content ~ Location + (1|Site),  data = eam.content.algae)
anova(eam.lme.algaecontent) # p = 0.9192
summary(eam.lme.algaecontent)

eam.lme.algaecontent2 <- lm(Content ~ Location,  data = eam.content.algae)
anova(eam.lme.algaecontent2) # 0.9538

# Detritus:
eam.content.detritus <- eam.content %>%
  dplyr::filter(StomachContent == "Detritus")

eam.lme.detcontent <- lmer(Content ~ Location + (1|Site),  data = eam.content.detritus)
anova(eam.lme.detcontent) # p = 0.9389

eam.lme.detcontent2 <- lm(Content ~ Location,  data = eam.content.detritus)
anova(eam.lme.detcontent2) # p = 0.9347

# Animal matter:
eam.content.animal <- eam.content %>%
  dplyr::filter(StomachContent == "Animalmatter")

eam.lme.animalcontent <- lmer(Content ~ Location + (1|Site),  data = eam.content.animal)
anova(eam.lme.animalcontent) # p = 0.4268

eam.lme.animalcontent2 <- lm(Content ~ Location,  data = eam.content.animal)
anova(eam.lme.animalcontent2) # p = 0.331

# Other:
eam.content.other <- eam.content %>%
  dplyr::filter(StomachContent == "Other")

eam.lme.othercontent <- lmer(Content ~ Location + (1|Site),  data = eam.content.other)
anova(eam.lme.othercontent) # p = 0.2267

eam.lme.othercontent2 <- lm(Content ~ Location,  data = eam.content.other)
anova(eam.lme.othercontent2) # p = 0.06157
```

### 16S

```{r echo=TRUE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=60)}
trans.adonis <- microbiome::transform(ps.eam, transform = "hellinger", target = "OTU", shift = 0, scale = 1)

unifrac <- phyloseq::distance(trans.adonis, method = "wunifrac")
sampledf <- data.frame(sample_data(trans.adonis))

# ADONIS
adonis2(formula = unifrac ~ Location * Location/Site, data = sampledf, strata = sampledf$Location, by = "terms")

### SITE NESTED IN LOCATION PERMDISP:
beta.site <- betadisper(unifrac, sampledf$Site)

permutest(beta.site,  permutations = 999,  strata = sampledf$Location)
```

## ADONIS 
### Fish stomach content

```{r echo=TRUE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=60)}
library(vegan)

# Then, load the downloaded data into R:
fish.content <- read.table("Fish_permanova_stomachcontent2.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(sum = Algae + Detritus + Animalmatter + Other) %>%
  filter(sum != 0.00) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sum)

# To set rownames for this data frame we do:
rownames(fish.content) <- fish.content$SampleID
fish.content$SampleID <- NULL 
fish.content <- as.matrix(fish.content)

sampledf <- data.frame(sample_data(sampledata)) %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% rownames(fish.content))
rownames(sampledf) <- sampledf$SampleID
sampledf$SampleID <- NULL

dis <- vegdist(fish.content, method = "euclidean")

adonis2(dis ~ Shifting/Species, data = sampledf, strata = sampledf$Shifting, by = "terms")

### Species NESTED IN Shifting PERMDISP:
beta.site <- betadisper(dis, sampledf$Species)

permutest(beta.site,  permutations = 999,  strata = sampledf$Shifting)
```

# Fish stomach content per SPECIES (StomachContent in separate files)
to get % algae for each species, summarised in table
```{r}
# https://www.datanovia.com/en/lessons/anova-in-r/
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

fish.content.algae <- read.table("Fish_stomachcontents_algae.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

fish.content.algae.summary <- fish.content.algae %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  get_summary_stats(Content, type = "mean_se")

ggboxplot(fish.content.algae, x = "Species", y = "Content")

# Check normality
model  <- lm(Content ~ Species, data = fish.content.algae)
ggqqplot(residuals(model))

# Compute Shapiro-Wilk test of normality
shapiro_test(residuals(model))

#Check normality assumption by Species
fish.content.algae %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  shapiro_test(Content) 
ggqqplot(fish.content.algae, "Content", facet.by = "Species")

# check the homogeneity of variances or Levene's test
fish.content.algae %>% levene_test(Content ~ Species)

# ANOVA
res.aov <- fish.content.algae %>% anova_test(Content ~ Species)
res.aov

# Pairwise comparisons - tukeys
pwc <- fish.content.algae %>% tukey_hsd(Content ~ Species)
pwc

# Visualization: box plots with p-values
pwc <- pwc %>% add_xy_position(x = "Species")
ggboxplot(fish.content.algae, x = "Species", y = "Content", color = "Species") +
  #facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(pwc, hide.ns = TRUE) +
  labs(
    subtitle = get_test_label(res.aov, detailed = TRUE),
    caption = get_pwc_label(pwc)
    ) +
  ylab("Content") + xlab ("Species")
```

## DETRITUS - to get % detritus for each species, summarised in table
```{r}
fish.content.detritus <- read.table("Fish_stomachcontents_detritus.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

fish.content.detritus.summary <- fish.content.detritus %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  get_summary_stats(Content, type = "mean_se")

ggboxplot(fish.content.detritus, x = "Species", y = "Content")

# Check normality
model  <- lm(Content ~ Species, data = fish.content.detritus)
ggqqplot(residuals(model))
# Compute Shapiro-Wilk test of normality
shapiro_test(residuals(model))

#Check normality assumption by Species
fish.content.detritus %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  shapiro_test(Content)
ggqqplot(fish.content.detritus, "Content", facet.by = "Species")

# check the homogeneity of variances or Levene's test
fish.content.detritus %>% levene_test(Content ~ Species)

# Kruskal
res.kruskal <- fish.content.detritus %>% 
  kruskal_test(Content ~ Species) 

# Pairwise comparisons using Dunn's test:
pwc <- fish.content.detritus %>% 
  dunn_test(Content ~ Species, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni") 
pwc

# Visualization: box plots with p-values
pwc <- pwc %>% add_xy_position(x = "Species")
ggboxplot(fish.content.detritus, x = "Species", y = "Content", 
          color = "Species") +
          #facet_wrap(~Site, ncol = 5) +
          stat_pvalue_manual(pwc, hide.ns = TRUE) +
          labs(
          subtitle = get_test_label(res.kruskal, detailed = TRUE),
          caption = get_pwc_label(pwc))
```

# PCoA
### Fish, EAM, water samples

```{r}
transall <- microbiome::transform(ps, transform = "hellinger", target = "OTU", shift = 0, scale = 1)
plotunifw <- ordinate(transall, method = "PCoA", distance = "unifrac", weighted = TRUE)
p <- plot_ordination(transall, plotunifw, color = "Sample_Type", shape = "Sample_Type") +
  geom_point(size = 4, aes(alpha = 0.6)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 16, 18)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
# Tidy up the colours 
p$layers <- p$layers[-1]

unif <- phyloseq::distance(ps, "wunifrac")
unif.ord <- ordinate(ps, method = "PCoA", unif)

p_jacc <- plot_ordination(ps, unif.ord, color = "Sample_Type", shape = "Sample_Type")
Fig2a <- p_jacc + geom_point(size = 4)  + theme_bw() + theme_classic() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11)) + stat_ellipse(aes(group = Sample_Type), level = 0.8) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, legend.position = "right") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 11), legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  labs(color = "Sample_Type", shape = "Sample_Type")
```

### EAM

```{r}
trans <- microbiome::transform(ps.eam, transform = "hellinger", target = "OTU", shift = 0, scale = 1)
plotunifw <- ordinate(trans, method = "PCoA", distance = "unifrac", weighted = TRUE)
p <- plot_ordination(trans, plotunifw, shape = "Location", color = "Site") +
  geom_point(size = 4, aes(alpha = 0.6)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 16)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

p$layers <- p$layers[-1]

# adding hull
unif <- phyloseq::distance(ps.eam, "wunifrac")
unif.ord <- ordinate(ps.eam, method = "PCoA", distance = unif)

p_jacc <- plot_ordination(ps.eam, unif.ord, shape = "Location", color = "Site")

Fig2c <- p_jacc +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Site, color = Site), level = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.position = "right") +
  labs(color = "Site", shape = "Location")

var_exp <- unif.ord$values$Relative_eig

x_lab <- paste0("PCoA1 (", round(var_exp[1] * 100, 1), "%)")
y_lab <- paste0("PCoA2 (", round(var_exp[2] * 100, 1), "%)")

Fig2c <- Fig2c +labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab)

Fig2 <- ggarrange(Fig2a, Fig2b, Fig2c,
                     labels = c("a)", "b)", "c)"),
                     font.label = list(size = 11, colour = "black", face = "plain"),
                     ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                     common.legend = FALSE, legend = NULL)
```

# PCoA with vectors
```{r}
ps.fish_sub <- subset_samples(ps.fish, !is.na(Algae))
unif <- phyloseq::distance(ps.fish_sub, "wunifrac")
df_contents <- sampledf %>%
  filter(sample_name %in% sample_names(ps.fish_sub)) %>%
  select(sample_name, Algae, Detritus, Animalmatter, Other) #%>%

pcoa_res <- wcmdscale(unif)
env_res <- envfit(pcoa_res, df_contents, permutations = 999) 
vectors <- as.data.frame(scores(env_res,  display = "vectors")) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "label")

plot_df <- vegan::scores(pcoa_res, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "sample_name") %>%
  left_join(., sampledf)

pcoa <- ape::pcoa(unif)
eig <- pcoa$values$Relative_eig
var_exp <- eig / sum(eig[eig > 0])

x_lab <- paste0("PCoA1 (", round(var_exp[1] * 100, 1), "%)")
y_lab <- paste0("PCoA2 (", round(var_exp[2] * 100, 1), "%)")

ggplot(plot_df, aes(Dim1, Dim2)) + geom_point(aes(shape = Shifting, color = Species, size = 2))  + theme_bw() + theme_classic() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11)) + stat_ellipse(aes(color = Species, group = Species), level = 0.80) +
  labs(color = "Species",  x = x_lab,  y = y_lab) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(17, 19), name = "Species") +
  geom_segment(data = vectors, aes(x = 0, xend = Dim1/5, y = 0, yend = Dim2/5), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11)) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), legend.title = element_text(size = 11), legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  geom_text(data = vectors, aes(x= Dim1/5, y = Dim2/5, label = label), size = 4)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(Dim1, Dim2)) + geom_point(aes(shape = Shifting, color = Shifting, size = 2))  + theme_bw() + theme_classic() + 
  scale_color_manual(values=c("darkblue", "red")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11)) + stat_ellipse(aes(color = Shifting, group = Shifting), level = 0.80) +
  labs(color = "Shifting",  x = x_lab,  y = y_lab) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(17, 19), name = "Shifting") +
  geom_segment(data = vectors, aes(x = 0, xend = Dim1/5, y = 0, yend = Dim2/5), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11)) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), legend.title = element_text(size = 11), legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  geom_text(data = vectors, aes(x = Dim1/5, y = Dim2/5, label = label), size = 4)
```

## ADONIS (PERMANOVA) 
### Nitrogen

```{r echo=TRUE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=60)}
library(vegan)

eam.n2 <- read.table("EAM_permanova_nitrogen.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

# To set rownames for this data frame we do:
rownames(eam.n2) <- eam.n2$SampleID
eam.n2$SampleID <- NULL
eam.n2 <- as.matrix(eam.n2)

sampledf <- data.frame(sample_data(sampledata)) %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% rownames(eam.n2))
rownames(sampledf) <- sampledf$SampleID
sampledf$SampleID <- NULL

dis <- vegdist(eam.n2, method = "euclidean")

adonis2(dis ~ Location/Site, data = sampledf, by = "terms")

adonis2(dis ~ Location/Site, data = sampledf, strata = sampledf$Location)

# PERMDISP (betadisper)
### SITE NESTED IN LOCATION PERMDISP:
beta.site <- betadisper(dis, sampledf$Site)

permutest(beta.site,  permutations = 999,  strata = sampledf$Location)
```

## PCoA: Fish, EAM, Water

```{r}
transall <- microbiome::transform(ps, transform = "hellinger", target = "OTU", shift = 0, scale = 1)
plotunifw <- ordinate(transall, method = "PCoA", distance = "unifrac", weighted = TRUE)
p <- plot_ordination(transall, plotunifw, color = "Sample_Type", shape = "Sample_Type") +
  geom_point(size = 4, aes(alpha = 0.6)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 16, 18)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

p$layers <- p$layers[-1]

unif <- phyloseq::distance(ps, "wunifrac")
unif.ord <- ordinate(ps, method = "PCoA", unif)

p_jacc <- plot_ordination(ps, unif.ord, color = "Sample_Type", shape = "Sample_Type")
p_jacc + geom_point(size = 6)  + theme_bw() + theme_classic() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11)) + stat_ellipse(aes(group = Sample_Type), level = 0.8) +
  labs("Sample_Type")
```

```{r}
bray <- phyloseq::distance(transfish, method = "bray")
sampledf <- data.frame(sample_data(transfish))

ps.fish_sub <- subset_samples(ps.fish, !is.na(Algae))
unif <- phyloseq::distance(ps.fish_sub, "wunifrac")
df_contents <- sampledf %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% sample_names(ps.fish_sub)) %>%
  select(SampleID,Algae, Detritus, Animalmatter, Other) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "SampleID")

pcoa_res <- wcmdscale(unif)
env_res <- envfit(pcoa_res, df_contents, permutations = 999)
vectors <- as.data.frame(scores(env_res,  display = "vectors")) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "label")

plot_df <- vegan::scores(pcoa_res, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "SampleID") %>%
  left_join(., sampledf)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(Dim1, Dim2)) + geom_point(aes(shape = Shifting, color = Species, size = 6))  + theme_bw() + theme_classic() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11)) + stat_ellipse(aes(color = Species, group = Species), level = 0.80) +
  labs("Species") + scale_shape_manual(values = c(17, 19), name = "Species") +
  geom_segment(data = vectors, aes(x = 0, xend = Dim1/5, y = 0, yend = Dim2/5), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))) +
  geom_text(data = vectors, aes(x= Dim1/5, y = Dim2/5, label = label), size = 4)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(Dim1, Dim2)) + geom_point(aes(shape = Shifting, color = Shifting, size = 6))  + theme_bw() + theme_classic() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11)) + stat_ellipse(aes(color = Shifting, group = Shifting), level = 0.60) +
  labs("Shifting") + scale_shape_manual(values = c(17, 19), name = "Shifting") +
  geom_segment(data = vectors, aes(x = 0, xend = Dim1/5, y = 0, yend = Dim2/5), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))) +
  geom_text(data = vectors, aes(x = Dim1/5, y = Dim2/5, label = label), size = 4)
```

```{r}

smallest <- min(sample_sums(ps.fish))

    legend.title = element_text(size = 11), legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
```

### Summary table
```{r}
library(car)
library(rstatix)

# Stats for Chao1
results.chao = estimate_richness(ps.pruned, measures = 'Chao1')

results.chao <- results.chao %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "sample_name")

meta <- data.frame(sample_name = sample_data(ps.pruned)$sample_name, 
                   Species = sample_data(ps.pruned)$Species,
                   Shifting = sample_data(ps.pruned)$Shifting)
meta$sample_name <- str_replace(meta$sample_name, "-", ".")
results.chao <- left_join(results.chao, meta)

Chao.summary <- results.chao %>%
                    group_by(Shifting) %>% 
                    get_summary_stats(Chao1, type = "common")

# Stats for Shannon
results.shan = estimate_richness(ps.pruned, measures = 'Shannon')

results.shan <- results.shan %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "sample_name")

meta <- data.frame(sample_name = sample_data(ps.pruned)$sample_name,
                   Species = sample_data(ps.pruned)$Species,
                   Shifting = sample_data(ps.pruned)$Shifting)
meta$sample_name <- str_replace(meta$sample_name, "-", ".")
results.shan <- left_join(results.shan, meta)

Shan.summary <- results.shan %>%
                    group_by(Shifting) %>% 
                    get_summary_stats(Shannon, type = "common")

# Summary table
summary.table <- rbind(Chao.summary, Shan.summary)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)

  dplyr::select(Shannon, Shifting, Species) %>%

summary(fish.lme.shan)

anova(fish.lme.shan2)

library(emmeans)
emmeans(fish.lme.shan, pairwise ~ Shifting)

# Chao1 richness

  dplyr::select(Chao1, Shifting, Species) %>%
  droplevels()

anova(fish.lme.chao)
summary(fish.lme.chao) #p = 0.201

fish.lme.chao2 <- lm(Chao1 ~ Species, data = alpha.fish.chao)
anova(fish.lme.chao2)
```

# Relative abundance
## FISH

```{r}
glom <- tax_glom(ps.fish, taxrank = "Phylum")

trans <- transform_sample_counts(glom, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)
trans_fish <- filter_taxa(trans, function(x) mean(x) > 0.01, TRUE)

long_fish <- psmelt(trans_fish) %>%
  group_by(OTU, Sample, sample_Species, Shifting, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Relative_abun = sum(Abundance/n()),
            SE_rel = sd(Abundance)/sqrt(n()))

library(RColorBrewer)

phyla_eam  <- unique(psmelt(trans_eam)$Phylum)
phyla_fish <- unique(psmelt(trans_fish)$Phylum)

all_phyla <- sort(unique(c(phyla_eam, phyla_fish)))

n <- length(all_phyla)

pal <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(n)
names(pal) <- all_phyla

long_fish$Phylum <- factor(long_fish$Phylum, levels = all_phyla)
theme_set(theme_bw())
ggplot(long_fish, aes(x = Sample, y = Relative_abun)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill = Phylum), colour = "black", position = "fill") +
    facet_wrap(~sample_Species*Shifting, scales = "free_x", ncol = 5) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = pal,
  breaks = all_phyla,   # ensures same legend order
  drop = TRUE          # keeps missing phyla in legend
) +   theme(aspect.ratio = 1, legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 11)) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11)) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11), axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11), legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 4)) +
    ylab("Relative Abundance (%)") + xlab("Replicate")
```

# Fish Physical factors
## Length
```{r}
# Tutorial here: https://www.datanovia.com/en/lessons/anova-in-r/
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

# Length
fish.length <- read.table("fish_specs_length.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

# Summary statistics table
fish.length.summary <- fish.length %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  get_summary_stats(Total_length, type = "mean_se")

ggboxplot(fish.length, x = "Species", y = "Total_length", color = "Species", palette = "jco")

# Check normality and homogeneity of variances
model  <- lm(Total_length ~ Species, data = fish.length)

# Shapiro-Wilk test of normality
shapiro_test(residuals(model))

# homogeneity of variances or Levene's test
fish.length %>% levene_test(Total_length ~ Species)

# ANOVA
res.aov <- fish.length %>% anova_test(Total_length ~ Species)

# Pairwise comparisons - tukeys
tukey <- fish.length %>% tukey_hsd(Total_length ~ Species)

# Visualization: box plots with p-values
tukey <- tukey %>% add_xy_position(x = "Species")
ggboxplot(fish.length, x = "Species", y = "Total_length", color = "Species") +
          stat_pvalue_manual(tukey, hide.ns = TRUE) +
          labs(
          subtitle = get_test_label(res.aov, detailed = TRUE),
          caption = get_pwc_label(tukey))
```

# Beta diversity
## FISH

```{r echo=TRUE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=60)}
trans.adonis <- microbiome::transform(ps.fish, transform = "hellinger", target = "OTU", shift = 0, scale = 1)

unifrac <- phyloseq::distance(trans.adonis, method = "wunifrac")
sampledf <- data.frame(sample_data(trans.adonis))

# ADONIS
adonis2(formula = unifrac ~ Shifting/Species, data = sampledf, strata = sampledf$Shifting, by = "terms")

# Shifting
beta.shift <- betadisper(unifrac, sampledf$Shifting)
boxplot(beta.shift)

anova(beta.shift)
beta.HSD <- TukeyHSD(beta.shift)
  plot(beta.HSD) 
  
plot(beta.shift)
permutest(beta.shift, pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 999)

beta.site <- betadisper(unifrac, sampledf$Site)

permutest(beta.site,  permutations = 999,  strata = sampledf$Shifting)

# Species
beta.species <- betadisper(unifrac, sampledf$Species) 
boxplot(beta.species)

anova(beta.species)
beta.HSD <- TukeyHSD(beta.species)
  plot(beta.HSD)

plot(beta.species)
permutest(beta.species, pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 999)

beta_perm <- permutest(beta.species, pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 999)
```

## Heatmap of fish-EAM similarity - taxa driving the differences
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

abund_table <- psmelt(tax_glommed) %>%
  group_by(Sample_Type, Species, Shifting, order, family, genus) %>%
  summarise(mean_abundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

abund_table <- abund_table %>%
  mutate(Order_Family_Genus = paste(order, family, genus, sep = "_"))


top_genera <- abund_table %>%
  filter(Sample_Type == "Fish") %>%
  group_by(Species, genus) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(mean_abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = mean_abund, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(genus)

heatmap_top <- abund_table %>%
  filter(genus %in% top_genera$genus) %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(Sample_Type == "EAM", "EAM", Species)) %>%
  group_by(Group, Order_Family_Genus) %>%
  summarise(mean_abundance = mean(mean_abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = mean_abundance) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Order_Family_Genus")

heatmap_top[is.na(heatmap_top)] <- 0

pheatmap(as.matrix(heatmap_top),  scale = "row",  cluster_rows = TRUE,  cluster_cols = FALSE,  color = colorRampPalette(c("royalblue1", "white", "orchid"))(100),  main = "Microbial family–genus composition of EAM and fish gut microbiomes (top 10 genera per species)",  fontsize = 10,  border_color = "grey60",  legend = TRUE)
```

# DESeq2
## GENUS

Note: Positive Log2 foldchange values represent higher abundance in left vs right Site name 
```{r}

library("DESeq2")
library("forcats")
library("tibble")
library("dplyr")

## Run at genus level
glom <- tax_glom(ps.fish, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE)

tax_df <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(glom), "matrix")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("TaxaID")

resultstax <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(glom), "matrix")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "TaxaID") %>%   # keep unique ID
  mutate(Genus = Genus)

alpha <- 0.05
ps.core.shifting <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(glom, ~ Shifting)
gm_mean <- function(x, na.rm = TRUE){
  exp(sum(log(x[x > 0]), na.rm = na.rm) / length(x))}
geoMeans <- apply(counts(ps.core.shifting), 1, gm_mean)
ps.core.shifting <- estimateSizeFactors(ps.core.shifting, geoMeans = geoMeans)
dsq <- DESeq(ps.core.shifting, fitType = "local")

Shifting <- results(
  dsq,
  cooksCutoff = FALSE,  contrast = c("Shifting", "Non_shifting", "Range_shifting")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("TaxaID") %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "TaxaID") %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, pvalue, padj) %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  mutate(test = "Non-range expanding v Range expanding")


# Plot
error <- Shifting$lfcSE

ggplot(Shifting, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = forcats::fct_rev(factor(order)))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_grid(~ test) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 16/9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0)


## OR COLOUR BY GROUP:
results.shifting <- rbind(Shifting) %>%
  mutate(class = fct_reorder(Class, log2FoldChange))

ggplot(results.shifting, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = reorder_within(Family, -log2FoldChange, Genus), colour = Phylum)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  facet_grid(~ test, scales = "free_x") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 50/9, legend.position = "right", panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  ylab("Family_Genus") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) 

## Subset plot of the top 20:
results.shifting2 <- results.shifting %>%
  mutate(
    Enriched_in = case_when(
      log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Non-range expanding",
      log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Range expanding",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))

top20 <- results.shifting2 %>%
  distinct(Genus, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%   # one entry per family
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  bind_rows(
    results.shifting2 %>%
      distinct(Genus, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      arrange(log2FoldChange) %>%
      slice_head(n = 15))

library(RColorBrewer)
results.shifting2$Order <- factor(results.shifting2$Order) # Need to convert order to a factor 

taxa_names <- levels(results.shifting2$Order)
base_colors <- brewer.pal(min(length(taxa_names), 12), "Paired")
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(base_colors)(length(taxa_names))
names(mycolors) <- taxa_names

# CHeck these are identical, otherwise colours don't map correctly:
levels(top20$Order)
names(mycolors)

ggplot(top20, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = reorder_within(Family, -log2FoldChange, Genus), colour = Order)) +  geom_point(size = 5) +  
  #scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = mycolors) +
  #scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  facet_grid(~ test, scales = "free_x") +
 theme_bw() + theme(aspect.ratio = 2/1,legend.position = "right",panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", size = 0.5),  panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "lightgrey", size = 0.5),  axis.text = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"), axis.title = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),  legend.title = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black")) + ylab("Family_Genus") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0) + xlim(-10, 30)


# How many unique genera are there?
results.shifting %>%  summarise(n_genus = n_distinct(Genus))

nrow(results.shifting)
```

```{r}
library("DESeq2")

gm_mean = function(x, na.rm = TRUE){  exp(sum(log(x[x > 0]), na.rm = na.rm) / length(x))} # calculate geometric means prior to estimate size factors

resultsNames(dsq)

  contrast = c("Shifting", "Non_shifting", "Range_shifting")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASVID") %>%
  left_join(resultstax, by = "ASVID") %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
```

```{r}
glom <- tax_glom(ps.fish, taxrank = "Genus")

flist <- filterfun(kOverA(n, 0))

  summarise(Average_rel = mean(Abundance),
```

## Eam vs Fish (core GENUS)
```{r}
library(ggvenn)

ps.eamfish <- subset_samples(ps, Sample_Type != "Water") # Removing WATER samples
ps.eamfish <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps.eamfish) > 1, ps.eamfish)

glom <- tax_glom(ps.eamfish, taxrank = "Genus")

# Fish
Fish <- subset_samples(glom, Sample_Type == "Fish")
Fish.trans <- transform_sample_counts(Fish, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)

n <- length(sample_names(Fish.trans))
flist <- filterfun(kOverA(n, 0))
a <- filter_taxa(Fish.trans, flist)
Fish_core <- prune_taxa(a, Fish.trans) 
Fish_core.melt <- psmelt(Fish_core) %>%
 group_by(Sample_Type, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, OTU) %>%
  summarise(Average_rel = mean(Abundance),
            SE_rel = sd(Abundance)/sqrt(n()))

# EAM
EAM <- subset_samples(glom, Sample_Type == "EAM")
EAM.trans <- transform_sample_counts(EAM, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)

n <- length(sample_names(EAM.trans))
flist <- filterfun(kOverA(n, 0))
a <- filter_taxa(EAM.trans, flist)
EAM_core <- prune_taxa(a, EAM.trans) 
EAM_core.melt <- psmelt(EAM_core) %>%
 group_by(Sample_Type, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, OTU) %>%
  summarise(Average_rel = mean(Abundance),
            SE_rel = sd(Abundance)/sqrt(n()))

# Plot
core_100_SampleType_genus <- rbind(Fish_core.melt, EAM_core.melt)

# Filter for OTUs with measurable abundance
present_otus <- core_100_SampleType_genus %>%
  filter(Average_rel > 0)

# Build Venn input
venn_list <- present_otus %>%
  group_by(Sample_Type) %>%
  summarise(otus = list(unique(OTU))) %>%
  deframe()

### PER SAMPLE TYPE
paired_type <- c("#33A02C",  "mediumpurple1")

venn_type <- present_otus %>%
  group_by(Sample_Type) %>%
  summarise(OTUs = list(unique(OTU)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

p_type <- ggvenn(
  venn_type,
  fill_color = paired_type,
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 11,
  text_size = 11,
  show_percentage = TRUE
) + ggtitle("Shared core genera between EAM & fish")

```
## EAM vs Fish - GENUS (Sorensen)
```{r}
ps <- readRDS("ps2026.rds")

ps.eamfish <- subset_samples(ps, Sample_Type != "Water") # Removing WATER samples
ps.eamfish <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps.eamfish) > 1, ps.eamfish)

glom <- tax_glom(ps.eamfish, taxrank = "Genus")

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)

# Ensure OTU table has taxa as rows
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(glom), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(glom)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

# Convert to presence/absence
otu_pa <- (otu_mat > 0) * 1

# Update phyloseq object
otu_table(glom) <- otu_table(otu_pa, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
ps_pa <- glom

# Compute similarity matrices
jaccard_sim <- 1 - as.matrix(vegdist(t(otu_pa), method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE))
sorensen_sim <- 1 - as.matrix(vegdist(t(otu_pa), method = "bray", binary = TRUE))

# Optional: inspect matrices
head(jaccard_sim)
head(sorensen_sim)

# Extract group information
sample_groups <- sample_data(ps_pa)$Sample_Type  # replace 'Group' with your variable
sample_ids <- rownames(sample_data(ps_pa))

# Function to compute average similarity between two groups
average_similarity <- function(sim_matrix, groups, group1, group2) {
  idx1 <- which(groups == group1)
  idx2 <- which(groups == group2)
  sim_values <- sim_matrix[idx1, idx2]
  mean(sim_values)
}

# Example: compute average similarity between 'EAM' and 'Gut'
avg_jaccard_EAM_Gut <- average_similarity(jaccard_sim, sample_groups, "EAM", "Fish")
avg_sorensen_EAM_Gut <- average_similarity(sorensen_sim, sample_groups, "EAM", "Fish")

library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Compute pairwise Jaccard similarities (as before)
# shared_matrix is already computed
ps_eam <- subset_samples(glom, Sample_Type == "EAM")
ps_gut <- subset_samples(glom, Sample_Type == "Fish")

# Convert OTU tables to presence/absence
otu_eam <- as(otu_table(ps_eam), "matrix") > 0
otu_gut <- as(otu_table(ps_gut), "matrix") > 0

# Initialize matrices
jaccard_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(otu_eam), ncol = ncol(otu_gut))
sorensen_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(otu_eam), ncol = ncol(otu_gut))
rownames(jaccard_matrix) <- colnames(otu_eam)
colnames(jaccard_matrix) <- colnames(otu_gut)
rownames(sorensen_matrix) <- colnames(otu_eam)
colnames(sorensen_matrix) <- colnames(otu_gut)

# Compute pairwise similarities
for(i in 1:ncol(otu_eam)){
  for(j in 1:ncol(otu_gut)){
    a <- sum(otu_eam[,i] & otu_gut[,j])          # shared taxa
    b <- sum(otu_eam[,i] | otu_gut[,j])          # union
    jaccard_matrix[i,j] <- a / b                 # Jaccard
    sorensen_matrix[i,j] <- 2 * a / (sum(otu_eam[,i]) + sum(otu_gut[,j]))  # Sørensen
  }
}

# Average similarities
avg_jaccard <- mean(jaccard_matrix)
avg_sorensen <- mean(sorensen_matrix)
cat("Average Jaccard similarity (EAM vs Gut):", avg_jaccard, "\n")
cat("Average Sørensen similarity (EAM vs Gut):", avg_sorensen, "\n")

# Prepare for plotting (long format)
jaccard_long <- melt(jaccard_matrix, varnames = c("EAM", "Fish"), value.name = "Similarity")
sorensen_long <- melt(sorensen_matrix, varnames = c("EAM", "Fish"), value.name = "Similarity")

# Create a simple data frame
avg_similarity <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Jaccard", "Sørensen"),
  Similarity = c(0.398715, 0.5541544))

# Bar plot
ggplot(avg_similarity, aes(x = Metric, y = Similarity, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Jaccard" = "skyblue", "Sørensen" = "orange")) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Shared Taxa Similarity between EAM and Fish",
       y = "Average Similarity", x = "") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Similarity, 3)), vjust = -0.5) #showing the average similarity between the two groups, and the numeric values displayed above the bars.
```

## Eam vs Fish - ASV - SORENSEN
### Jaccard or Sørensen overlap
```{r}
ps <- readRDS("ps2026.rds")

psfisheam <- subset_samples(ps, Sample_Type != "Water") # Removing water samples
psfisheam  <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(psfisheam) > 1, psfisheam)

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)

# Ensure OTU table has taxa as rows
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(psfisheam), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(psfisheam)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

# Convert to presence/absence
otu_pa <- (otu_mat > 0) * 1

# Update phyloseq object
otu_table(psfisheam) <- otu_table(otu_pa, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
ps_pa <- psfisheam

# Compute similarity matrices
jaccard_sim <- 1 - as.matrix(vegdist(t(otu_pa), method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE))
sorensen_sim <- 1 - as.matrix(vegdist(t(otu_pa), method = "bray", binary = TRUE))

# Optional: inspect matrices
head(jaccard_sim)
head(sorensen_sim)

# Extract group information
sample_groups <- sample_data(ps_pa)$Sample_Type  # replace 'Group' with your variable
sample_ids <- rownames(sample_data(ps_pa))

# Function to compute average similarity between two groups
average_similarity <- function(sim_matrix, groups, group1, group2) {
  idx1 <- which(groups == group1)
  idx2 <- which(groups == group2)
  sim_values <- sim_matrix[idx1, idx2]
  mean(sim_values)
}

# Example: compute average similarity between 'EAM' and 'Gut'
avg_jaccard_EAM_Gut <- average_similarity(jaccard_sim, sample_groups, "EAM", "Fish")
avg_sorensen_EAM_Gut <- average_similarity(sorensen_sim, sample_groups, "EAM", "Fish")

library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Compute pairwise Jaccard similarities (as before)
# shared_matrix is already computed
ps_eam <- subset_samples(psfisheam, Sample_Type == "EAM")
ps_gut <- subset_samples(psfisheam, Sample_Type == "Fish")

# Convert OTU tables to presence/absence
otu_eam <- as(otu_table(ps_eam), "matrix") > 0
otu_gut <- as(otu_table(ps_gut), "matrix") > 0

# Initialize matrices
jaccard_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(otu_eam), ncol = ncol(otu_gut))
sorensen_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(otu_eam), ncol = ncol(otu_gut))
rownames(jaccard_matrix) <- colnames(otu_eam)
colnames(jaccard_matrix) <- colnames(otu_gut)
rownames(sorensen_matrix) <- colnames(otu_eam)
colnames(sorensen_matrix) <- colnames(otu_gut)

# Compute pairwise similarities
for(i in 1:ncol(otu_eam)){
  for(j in 1:ncol(otu_gut)){
    a <- sum(otu_eam[,i] & otu_gut[,j])          # shared taxa
    b <- sum(otu_eam[,i] | otu_gut[,j])          # union
    jaccard_matrix[i,j] <- a / b                 # Jaccard
    sorensen_matrix[i,j] <- 2 * a / (sum(otu_eam[,i]) + sum(otu_gut[,j]))  # Sørensen
  }
}

# Average similarities
avg_jaccard <- mean(jaccard_matrix)
avg_sorensen <- mean(sorensen_matrix)
cat("Average Jaccard similarity (EAM vs Gut):", avg_jaccard, "\n") # Average Jaccard similarity (EAM vs Gut): 0.1570111 
cat("Average Sørensen similarity (EAM vs Gut):", avg_sorensen, "\n") # Average Sørensen similarity (EAM vs Gut): 0.2589675

# Prepare for plotting (long format)
jaccard_long <- melt(jaccard_matrix, varnames = c("EAM", "Fish"), value.name = "Similarity")
sorensen_long <- melt(sorensen_matrix, varnames = c("EAM", "Fish"), value.name = "Similarity")

# Heatmap for Jaccard # Darker blue tiles → higher similarity (more shared taxa) between that EAM–Gut pair.
ggplot(jaccard_long, aes(x = Fish, y = EAM, fill = Similarity)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Pairwise Jaccard Similarity (EAM vs Gut)", x = "Fish Samples", y = "EAM Samples") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Heatmap for Sørensen
ggplot(sorensen_long, aes(x = Fish, y = EAM, fill = Similarity)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkgreen") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Pairwise Sørensen Similarity (EAM vs Gut)", x = "Fish Samples", y = "EAM Samples") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Create a simple data frame
avg_similarity <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Jaccard", "Sørensen"),
  Similarity = c(0.1570111, 0.2589675)
)

# Bar plot
ggplot(avg_similarity, aes(x = Metric, y = Similarity, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Jaccard" = "skyblue", "Sørensen" = "orange")) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Shared Taxa Similarity between EAM and Fish",
       y = "Average Similarity", x = "") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Similarity, 3)), vjust = -0.5)

```

# Relative abundance of core to overall relative abundance
```{r}
# Extract OTU matrix
otu <- as(otu_table(ps.fish), "matrix")

# Ensure samples are rows
if (taxa_are_rows(ps.fish)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

# Define core taxa
core_taxa <- taxa_names(ps.core.fishASVtree)

# Calculate core and non-core abundance per sample
core_sum <- rowSums(
  otu[, colnames(otu) %in% core_taxa, drop = FALSE]
)

total_sum <- rowSums(otu)

df_core <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(otu),
  core = core_sum,
  other = total_sum - core_sum
)

# Convert to relative abundance
df_core <- df_core %>%
  mutate(
    core = core / (core + other),
    other = other / (core + other)
  )

# Add metadata
meta <- as(sample_data(ps.fish), "data.frame")
meta$Sample <- rownames(meta)

df_core <- df_core %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "Sample")

library(glmmTMB)
m1 <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(core, other) ~ Shifting,
  family = binomial(),
  data = df_core)

summary(m1)

m2 <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(core, other) ~ Shifting + Species,
  family = binomial(),
  data = df_core)
drop1(m2, test = "Chisq")



# Long format for plotting
df_long <- df_core %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(core, other),
    names_to = "is_core",
    values_to = "core_abund"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_core = factor(is_core, levels = c("other", "core"))
  )

# Plot
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Sample, y = core_abund, fill = is_core)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~Shifting * Species, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey85", "steelblue2")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("Relative abundance (%)") +
  xlab("Replicate")

# Summarise mean core contribution by shifting group
core_summary <- df_core %>%
  group_by(Shifting) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_core = mean(core, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_core = sd(core, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_core = sd_core / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),  .groups = "drop")
```

## STATS - Core OTUs - percent shared EAM + fish species
```{r}
# https://www.datanovia.com/en/lessons/anova-in-r/
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

sharedcore <- read.table("core_percent_shared2026.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

# Summary statistics table
sharedcore.summary <- sharedcore %>%
  group_by(Shifting) %>%
  get_summary_stats(percent, type = "mean_se")

ggboxplot(sharedcore, x = "Shifting", y = "percent", color = "Shifting", palette = "jco")

# Check normality and homogeneity of variances
model  <- lm(percent ~ Shifting, data = sharedcore)
ggqqplot(residuals(model))
# Shapiro-Wilk test of normality
shapiro_test(residuals(model))

# homogeneity of variances or Levene's test
sharedcore %>% levene_test(percent ~ Shifting)

# ANOVA
res.aov <- sharedcore %>% anova_test(percent ~ Shifting)
res.aov

# Pairwise comparisons - tukeys
pwc <- sharedcore %>% tukey_hsd(percent ~ Shifting)
pwc

# Visualization: box plots with p-values
pwc <- pwc %>% add_xy_position(x = "Shifting")
ggboxplot(sharedcore, x = "Shifting", y = "percent", 
          color = "Shifting") +
          stat_pvalue_manual(pwc, hide.ns = TRUE) +
          labs(
          subtitle = get_test_label(res.aov, detailed = TRUE),
          caption = get_pwc_label(pwc))
```

# COMPARE Fish and EAM overlap

## How many taxa are shared between EAM and gut microbiomes?

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)

ps <- readRDS("ps2026.rds")

psfisheam <- subset_samples(ps, Sample_Type != "Water") # Removing water samples
psfisheam  <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(psfisheam) > 1, psfisheam)

# Convert to presence/absence
otu_pa <- (otu_table(psfisheam) > 0) * 1
otu_pa <- as(otu_pa, "matrix")

# Sample metadata
samp_df <- data.frame(sample_data(psfisheam))

all(rownames(otu_pa) %in% rownames(samp_df))
all(rownames(samp_df) %in% rownames(otu_pa))

taxa_are_rows(psfisheam)

if(taxa_are_rows(psfisheam)) {
  otu_pa <- t(otu_pa)
}

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(otu_pa), rownames(samp_df))
otu_pa <- otu_pa[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
samp_df <- samp_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# Function to compute number of shared ASVs between two groups
shared_asvs <- function(group1, group2, otu_mat, samp_df, group_var = "Shifting") {
  samples1 <- rownames(samp_df[samp_df[[group_var]] %in% group1, ])
  samples2 <- rownames(samp_df[samp_df[[group_var]] %in% group2, ])
  
  otu1 <- otu_mat[samples1, , drop = FALSE]
  otu2 <- otu_mat[samples2, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # ASVs present in each group
  asvs1 <- colSums(otu1) > 0
  asvs2 <- colSums(otu2) > 0
  
  shared_count <- sum(asvs1 & asvs2)
  total_asvs <- c(sum(asvs1), sum(asvs2))
  
  tibble(
    Group1 = paste(group1, collapse = ", "),
    Group2 = paste(group2, collapse = ", "),
    Shared_ASVs = shared_count,
    ASVs_Group1 = total_asvs[1],
    ASVs_Group2 = total_asvs[2]
  )
}

# Comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("EAM", "Fish"),
  c("EAM", "Range_shifting"),
  c("EAM", "Non_shifting")
)

# Calculate shared ASVs for each comparison
shared_results <- map_dfr(comparisons, ~shared_asvs(.x[1], .x[2], otu_pa, samp_df))

print(shared_results)
summary(shared_results)

                                      
# Plot shared ASVs
shared_results_long <- shared_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("ASVs_Group1", "ASVs_Group2", "Shared_ASVs"),
               names_to = "Type", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Type = recode(Type,
                       ASVs_Group1 = "Group1 ASVs",
                       ASVs_Group2 = "Group2 ASVs",
                       Shared_ASVs = "Shared ASVs"))

ggplot(shared_results_long, aes(x = interaction(Group1, Group2), y = Count, fill = Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  labs(x = "Comparison", y = "Number of ASVs", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

# Compare EAM vs Non_Shifting and EAM vs Range_Shifting
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Convert OTU table to presence/absence
otu_pa <- as(otu_table(psfisheam), "matrix") > 0

# Sample metadata
samp_df <- as(sample_data(psfisheam), "data.frame")

if(taxa_are_rows(psfisheam)) {
  otu_pa <- t(otu_pa)
}

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(otu_pa), rownames(samp_df))
otu_pa <- otu_pa[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
samp_df <- samp_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# Function to compute average Jaccard and Sørensen similarity between two groups
compute_similarity <- function(otu_matrix, sample_data, group_var, group1, group2) {
  samples1 <- rownames(sample_data[sample_data[[group_var]] == group1, ])
  samples2 <- rownames(sample_data[sample_data[[group_var]] == group2, ])
  
  otu1 <- otu_matrix[samples1, , drop = FALSE]
  otu2 <- otu_matrix[samples2, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Jaccard similarity
  jaccard_dist <- vegdist(rbind(otu1, otu2), method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
  jaccard_mat <- as.matrix(jaccard_dist)
  sim_values <- jaccard_mat[1:nrow(otu1), (nrow(otu1)+1):(nrow(otu1)+nrow(otu2))]
  avg_jaccard <- mean(1 - sim_values)
  
  # Sørensen similarity (binary Bray-Curtis)
  bray_dist <- vegdist(rbind(otu1, otu2), method = "bray", binary = TRUE)
  bray_mat <- as.matrix(bray_dist)
  avg_sorensen <- mean(1 - bray_mat)
  
  return(data.frame(
    Comparison = paste(group1, "vs", group2),
    Jaccard = avg_jaccard,
    Sorensen = avg_sorensen
  ))
}

# Define comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("EAM", "Non_shifting"),
  c("EAM", "Range_shifting")
)

# Run comparisons
sim_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(comparisons, function(x) {
  compute_similarity(otu_pa, samp_df, "Shifting", x[1], x[2])
}))

print(sim_results)

# Plot
sim_long <- sim_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Jaccard, Sorensen), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Similarity")

ggplot(sim_long, aes(x = Comparison, y = Similarity, fill = Comparison)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(title = "Average Microbiome Similarity Between Groups",
       y = "Similarity",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "darkorange")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, nrow = 1)

```

### Compare CORE EAM vs Non_Shifting and EAM vs Range_Shifting
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

ps.corefishEAMASV <- readRDS("ps.corefishEAMASV.rds") 

# Convert OTU table to presence/absence
otu_pa <- as(otu_table(ps.corefishEAMASV), "matrix") > 0

# Sample metadata
samp_df <- as(sample_data(ps.corefishEAMASV), "data.frame")

if(taxa_are_rows(ps.corefishEAMASV)) {
  otu_pa <- t(otu_pa)
}

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(otu_pa), rownames(samp_df))
otu_pa <- otu_pa[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
samp_df <- samp_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# Function to compute average Jaccard and Sørensen similarity between two groups
compute_similarity <- function(otu_matrix, sample_data, group_var, group1, group2) {
  samples1 <- rownames(sample_data[sample_data[[group_var]] == group1, ])
  samples2 <- rownames(sample_data[sample_data[[group_var]] == group2, ])
  
  otu1 <- otu_matrix[samples1, , drop = FALSE]
  otu2 <- otu_matrix[samples2, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Jaccard similarity
  jaccard_dist <- vegdist(rbind(otu1, otu2), method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
  jaccard_mat <- as.matrix(jaccard_dist)
  sim_values <- jaccard_mat[1:nrow(otu1), (nrow(otu1)+1):(nrow(otu1)+nrow(otu2))]
  avg_jaccard <- mean(1 - sim_values)
  
  # Sørensen similarity (binary Bray-Curtis)
  bray_dist <- vegdist(rbind(otu1, otu2), method = "bray", binary = TRUE)
  bray_mat <- as.matrix(bray_dist)
  avg_sorensen <- mean(1 - bray_mat)
  
  return(data.frame(
    Comparison = paste(group1, "vs", group2),
    Jaccard = avg_jaccard,
    Sorensen = avg_sorensen
  ))
}

# Define comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("EAM", "Non_shifting"),
  c("EAM", "Range_shifting")
)

# Run comparisons
sim_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(comparisons, function(x) {
  compute_similarity(otu_pa, samp_df, "Shifting", x[1], x[2])
}))

print(sim_results)

# Plot
sim_long <- sim_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Jaccard, Sorensen), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Similarity")

ggplot(sim_long, aes(x = Comparison, y = Similarity, fill = Comparison)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(title = "Average Core Microbiome Similarity Between Groups",
       y = "Similarity",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "darkorange")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, nrow = 1)

```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(VennDiagram)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

ps <- readRDS("ps2026.rds")

psfisheam <- subset_samples(ps, Sample_Type != "Water") # Removing water samples
psfisheam  <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(psfisheam) > 1, psfisheam)

# Extract sample metadata
samp_df <- data.frame(sample_data(psfisheam))

# Ensure OTU table has samples as rows
otu_pa <- otu_table(psfisheam)
if(taxa_are_rows(otu_pa)) {
  otu_pa <- t(otu_pa)   # transpose so samples are rows
}
otu_pa <- (otu_pa > 0) * 1
otu_pa <- as(otu_pa, "matrix")

# Align OTU matrix with metadata
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(otu_pa), rownames(samp_df))
otu_pa <- otu_pa[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
samp_df <- samp_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# calculate shared ASVs 
shared_asvs <- function(group1, group2, otu_mat, samp_df, group_var = "Shifting") {
  samples1 <- rownames(samp_df[samp_df[[group_var]] %in% group1, ])
  samples2 <- rownames(samp_df[samp_df[[group_var]] %in% group2, ])
  
  otu1 <- otu_mat[samples1, , drop = FALSE]
  otu2 <- otu_mat[samples2, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # ASVs present in each group
  asvs1 <- colSums(otu1) > 0
  asvs2 <- colSums(otu2) > 0
  
  shared_count <- sum(asvs1 & asvs2)
  total_asvs <- c(sum(asvs1), sum(asvs2))
  
  tibble(
    Group1 = paste(group1, collapse = ", "),
    Group2 = paste(group2, collapse = ", "),
    Shared_ASVs = shared_count,
    ASVs_Group1 = total_asvs[1],
    ASVs_Group2 = total_asvs[2]
  )
}

# Define comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("EAM", "Range_shifting"),
  c("EAM", "Non_shifting"),
  c("EAM", "Fish")  # optional, if Fish is included
)

# Calculate shared ASVs
shared_results <- map_dfr(comparisons, ~shared_asvs(.x[1], .x[2], otu_pa, samp_df))
print(shared_results)

# Venn diagram plotting function
plot_venn_grob <- function(shared_row) {
  EAM_only <- shared_row$ASVs_Group1 - shared_row$Shared_ASVs
  other_only <- shared_row$ASVs_Group2 - shared_row$Shared_ASVs
  shared <- shared_row$Shared_ASVs
  
  # Capture the Venn diagram as a grob
  grob <- grid.grabExpr(
    draw.pairwise.venn(
      area1 = EAM_only + shared,
      area2 = other_only + shared,
      cross.area = shared,
      category = c(shared_row$Group1, shared_row$Group2),
      fill = c("skyblue", "forestgreen"),
      alpha = 0.5,
      cex = 1.5,
      cat.cex = 1.5,
      cat.pos = c(-20, 20),
      print.mode = "raw"
    )
  )
  return(grob)
}

# Apply to each row of shared_results
venn_list <- lapply(1:nrow(shared_results), function(i) plot_venn_grob(shared_results[i, ]))

# Arrange side by side
grid.arrange(grobs = venn_list, ncol = nrow(shared_results))
```
### glmmTMB
```{r}
library(glmmTMB)
library(dplyr)

overlap_df <- shared_results %>%
  mutate(
    prop_shared = Shared_ASVs / ASVs_Group1,
    prop_shared_adj = ifelse(prop_shared == 0, 0.001,
                             ifelse(prop_shared == 1, 0.999, prop_shared)))

# Ensure Shifting and Species are factors
overlap_df$Shifting <- factor(overlap_df$Group2) 
overlap_df$Species <- factor(overlap_df$Group1)  

model <- glmmTMB(
  prop_shared_adj ~ Shifting,
  family = beta_family(),
  data = overlap_df
)

drop1(model, test = "Chisq")
```
